scientific_integrity: Analytical derivation reconstructed with explicit boundary conditions, positive-rate domain, locally uniform asymptotics and reproducible bounded checks; no claim of independent certification.
scientific_limitations: The sign boundary is local to fast environmental refresh and mean reset rates near the classical optimum; no uniqueness at arbitrary refresh speeds or full first-passage law is proved. Full text was inaccessible for some peripheral prior work. Numerical finite checks supplement rather than replace the proof. Priority remains qualified pending independent assessment.
title: A sharp fast-refresh search threshold for two positive fluctuating reset intensities
